description: This file contains unit tests for the ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter component, verifying its behavior in different session, security, prompt, and fallback decision scenarios.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompterTests
classes.description: A struct containing multiple unit tests for ExecApprovalsGatewayPrompter.

methods.name: session match prefers active session
methods.description: Tests that the prompter correctly matches the active session preference.

methods.name: session fallback uses recent activity
methods.description: Checks if recent activity prompts are correctly considered when active session is nil.

methods.name: default behavior matches mode
methods.description: Validates that default prompts align with the specified mode (local or remote).

methods.name: askAlwaysPromptsRegardlessOfSecurity
methods.description: Ensures that in 'ask always' mode, prompts occur regardless of security settings.

methods.name: askOnMissPromptsOnlyForAllowlist
methods.description: Ensures prompts occur only when security is allowlist and ask policy is 'onMiss'.

methods.name: askOffNeverPrompts
methods.description: Verifies that when prompt policy is 'off', no prompts are triggered regardless of security setting.

methods.name: fallbackAllowlistAllowsMatchingResolvedPath
methods.description: Tests that allowlist patterns correctly grant access when matched.

methods.name: fallbackAllowlistDeniesAllowlistMiss
methods.description: Tests that a command is denied when it does not match any allowlist pattern.

methods.name: fallbackFullAllowsWhenPromptCannotBeShown
methods.description: Ensures fallback decision defaults to allow when prompts cannot be presented.
